description: This file defines React components related to filters in a job exploration interface, including input fields for job title, industry, skills, and salary range, as well as components for displaying active filter tags and sliders.

methods.name: TextFilter
methods.description: A reusable component for text-based filter inputs, with customizable label, placeholder, and styling based on 'isCompact'.

methods.name: SkillsInput
methods.description: Component for inputting and parsing a comma-separated list of skills.
